name: orbit-flip-slider
title: Orbit Flip Slider
description: GSAP Flip-driven gallery that morphs one ring of images between four camera views - a flat circle, a zoomed-in upper arc, a tilted 3D ring, and a coverflow band - with a bouncy 3D hover tilt on every card.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color behind the ring.

props.name: imageWidth
props.description: Width of each image card in pixels.

props.name: imageHeight
props.description: Height of each image card in pixels.

props.name: imageGap
props.description: Extra spacing between image cards in pixels.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Tailwind border-radius class applied to each image card.

props.name: enableHoverMovement
props.description: Enables the hover lift and perspective tilt on image cards.

props.name: hoverMoveY
props.description: Vertical movement applied to the image card on hover, in pixels.

props.name: perspectiveRotateValue
props.description: How far each card rotates on hover, in degrees.

props.name: perspectiveRotateDirection
props.description: Direction each card rotates on hover.

props.name: rotate
props.description: Continuously and slowly rotates the ring of cards.

props.name: rotateSpeed
props.description: Speed of the automatic rotation, in degrees per second.

props.name: stopRotationOnHover
props.description: Pauses the automatic rotation while the pointer is hovering the slider.

props.name: flatRadiusX
props.description: Horizontal stretch of the flat circle, as a multiplier of its base radius.

props.name: flatRadiusY
props.description: Vertical stretch of the flat circle, as a multiplier of its base radius.

props.name: flatScale
props.description: Uniform zoom on the flat circle as a whole - position spread and card size together.

props.name: ringRotateX
props.description: Rotates the ring's plane on the x axis, in degrees. Swings the near/far cards vertically apart.

props.name: ringRotateY
props.description: Rotates the ring on the y axis, in degrees. Spins which card faces the camera.

props.name: ringRotateZ
props.description: Rotates the whole projected ring on the z axis, in degrees. Spins the composition in place, like a wheel face.

props.name: ringRadiusX
props.description: Horizontal stretch of the ring, as a multiplier of its base radius.

props.name: ringRadiusY
props.description: Vertical stretch of the ring, as a multiplier of its base radius.

props.name: ringScale
props.description: Uniform zoom on the ring as a whole - position spread and card size together, like moving the camera closer or further on the z axis.

props.name: tiltRotateX
props.description: Rotates the tilt view's ring on the x axis, in degrees.

props.name: tiltRotateY
props.description: Rotates the tilt view's ring on the y axis, in degrees. Shifts which part of the upper arc is centered.

props.name: tiltRotateZ
props.description: Rotates the whole projected tilt composition on the z axis, in degrees.

props.name: tiltRadiusX
props.description: Horizontal stretch of the tilt view, as a multiplier of its base radius.

props.name: tiltRadiusY
props.description: Vertical stretch of the tilt view, as a multiplier of its base radius.

props.name: tiltScale
props.description: Uniform zoom on the tilt view as a whole.

props.name: tiltMoveY
props.description: Pans the tilt view up or down, in pixels, without affecting its rotation, stretch or zoom.

props.name: galleryRotateX
props.description: Rotates the gallery coverflow's ring on the x axis, in degrees.

props.name: galleryRotateY
props.description: Rotates the gallery coverflow on the y axis, in degrees. Spins which card faces the camera.

props.name: galleryRotateZ
props.description: Rotates the whole projected gallery composition on the z axis, in degrees.

props.name: galleryRadiusX
props.description: Horizontal stretch of the gallery coverflow, as a multiplier of its base radius.

props.name: galleryRadiusY
props.description: Vertical stretch of the gallery coverflow, as a multiplier of its base radius.

props.name: galleryScale
props.description: Uniform zoom on the gallery coverflow as a whole.
